name: Zzap!
author: simonjordan557
description: My personal project from Create With Code. It's a frenetic twin-stick shooter. inspired by 80's arcade, Llamasoft and Atari 2600 games. Use a joypad! Fight aggressively to increase your score multiplier and spawn more power-ups. Watch out for rockets, bombs, bullets, and weird aggressive alien things. I made all the assets myself. It's been a long week.
